QuestInfo.name: [Red Leaf High] Chapter 1: Classroom Under Construction
QuestInfo.1: Homeroom Teacher #p9000127# tells you studies must continue after the long vacation but the ghosts who have appeared at Red Leaf High have destroyed the desks and chairs making it impossible to hold a class.\nAnd in order to resume with the classes, the Broken Desk and Chairs have to be repaired but the ghosts continue to interfere and so the caretaker cannot do anything . Enter the #bClassroom Under Construction#k and find the #bwooden boxes that contain #erepair tools#n to repair #eall desks and chairs#n#k.
QuestInfo.2: Homeroom Teacher #p9000127# has said that studies must continue after the long vacation but the ghosts who have appeared at Red Leaf High have destroyed the desks and chairs making it impossible to hold a class.\nAnd in order to resume with classes, the repair tools hidden in the Classroom Under Construction were found  and used to repair the broken desks and chairs.
QuestInfo.parent: [Red Leaf High] Ghost of Red Leaf High

0.0: Hey there #b#h0##k. Did you enjoy your vacation? I know you're eager to get back to your studies but we have a problem. The ghosts appeared over the vacation and took over the school. They're going around destroying everything and locking classrooms up.
0.1: No thanks to them there isn't a single usable desk or chair around anymore. We have to repair the broken desks and chairs before we can start the lessons, but the ghosts scared away the caretaker! I don't know what to do...
0.2: Oh I know, you like sports right? Why don't you go into #bclassrooms under construction#k and repair the broken desks and chairs? The repairman dropped his repair tools when he was running away. I bet the ghosts hit the tools in #bwooden boxes#k.

yes.0: I locked up the classrooms so that the ghosts can't come out. Let me know when you're ready. \r\n#b#eThe door on the right#k#n will take you to the classroom in repair.

no.0: There can be no classes without chairs and desks!
